title: The same board read as JSON: the cutouts of the pour and the opening of the outline are kept
how: Counted from the file: one zone with a `cutouts` list of 2 polygons, and an `outline_cutouts` list of 1 polygon;
a track, 2 vias, 2 components with 3 pads each as placed (6) and 1 net, the same as the board it was made from; 4 outline points.
